newsitem.title: USA: Crescent to buy Carter-Crowley Properties.
newsitem.headline: Crescent to buy Carter-Crowley Properties.

text.p: Crescent Real Estate Equities Co said on Thursday that it has agreed to buy nearly all of the assets of Carter-Crowley Properties Inc, which includes 14 office properties, land, and equity and debt interests in the Dallas Mavericks NBA franchise.
Financial terms of the deal were not immediately available.
The office properties total three million square feet over seven suburban Dallas areas, Crescent said.
Crescent Real Estate said the deal is scheduled to close by the end of April 1997, subject to due diligence and other closing conditions.

Crescent is a real estate investment trust consisting of 71 office properties and six retail properties totaling 21.5 million square feet, 92 behavioral healthcare facilities, four hotels and other assorted real estate interests.
